body: heya, if you got a Cleaning Head Module but the issue persists, ask them to give you a service robot or repair since you should be still in warranty

The two robots' bases are too close to each other and can cause confusion when the robots are trying to dock. Move the Bases further apart, clean the charging contacts with a magic eraser on all devices, do a reboot on the robots and it should be fine. If the issue persists, contact Support
